sampling_principles: 1. MODEL-BLIND SAMPLING: Pairs must never be selected based on existing model predictions or embedding similarities, avoiding selection bias.
2. STRATIFIED DOMAIN COVERAGE: Balanced representation across software engineering, data science/ML, DevOps/cloud, product/project management, and QA.
3. EXPERIENCE SPREAD: Controlled mix of Junior (0-2 yrs), Mid-level (2-5 yrs), Senior (5-8 yrs), and Lead/Staff (8+ yrs).
4. BOUNDED ENTITY REUSE: Strictly max 5 pairs per candidate, max 10 pairs per job.
5. STRICT PROTOCOL QUARANTINE: Unseen entities only; zero hash intersection with internal training manifests.

quarantine_and_isolation_rules.pre_annotation_deduplication: Exact and near-duplicate text deduplication using SHA-256 and MinHash LSH (threshold 0.85).
quarantine_and_isolation_rules.overlap_audit_with_internal_splits: Candidate resume texts and job descriptions must have 0% hash intersection with manifests/v1/dual_unseen_train_v1.parquet and held_out_test_v1.parquet.
quarantine_and_isolation_rules.access_control: Benchmark ground-truth labels stored in encrypted/restricted directory; excluded from all training pipelines and model parameter tuning scripts.
